name: Marble Kitchen Counter
description: A honed white-veined marble counter in a real, lived-in kitchen, caught in low warm morning window light — the intimate human scale of an actual home rather than an epic studio set.
lighting: Low warm morning window light, soft directional shadows
subject: product
prompt: A glass jar labeled 'Hearth & Grain — Toasted Oat Granola' staged on a honed white-veined marble kitchen counter at a three-quarter angle and counter height as if the viewer is standing at the counter, warm low morning window light raking in from one side with soft directional shadows and a genuine specular catch along the marble's veining, a worn wood cutting board and a linen tea towel positioned at the edge of frame, a real lived-in kitchen with natural food styling and no glossy fake-food sheen, shallow depth of field letting the counter's texture and the room beyond fall softly out of focus around the sharp subject, no other people, no visible face, no props that don't belong in a real kitchen
